envVars.SENDMUX_ACCESS_TOKEN: Optional externally managed OAuth access token for CLI HTTP requests; the CLI does not refresh it.
envVars.SENDMUX_API_KEY: Optional Qubrics API key or scoped agent token used by CLI, SDK, HTTP, or MCP examples.
envVars.SENDMUX_ROOT_KEY: Optional Qubrics root key for account-level Management API setup.
envVars.SENDMUX_MBX_KEY: Optional Qubrics mailbox key for Mailbox and send-capable mailbox workflows.
envVars.SENDMUX_BASE_URL: Optional Qubrics API base URL override for CLI examples.
envVars.SENDMUX_MCP_SURFACES: Optional comma-separated surfaces for the combined Qubrics MCP server.
envVars.SENDMUX_MAILBOX_API_KEY: Optional mailbox key for the Mailbox surface in the combined MCP server.
envVars.SENDMUX_MANAGEMENT_API_KEY: Optional root key for the Management surface in the combined MCP server.
envVars.SENDMUX_SENDING_API_KEY: Optional send-capable mailbox key or owner-approved agent token for the Sending MCP surface.
envVars.SENDMUX_MCP_HTTP_BEARER_TOKEN: Optional bearer token expected by the local HTTP MCP server.
envVars.SENDMUX_MCP_OPENAPI_INPUT_DIR: Schema directory override. Leave unset in this workflow.
envVars.SENDMUX_MCP_APP_OPENAPI: App schema override. Leave unset in this workflow.
envVars.SENDMUX_MCP_SENDING_OPENAPI: Sending schema override. Leave unset in this workflow.
envVars.SENDMUX_MCP_ALLOW_UNAUTHENTICATED_HTTP: Disables HTTP authentication when enabled. Leave unset in this workflow.
envVars.QUBRICS_ACCESS_TOKEN: Optional externally managed OAuth access token for CLI HTTP requests; the CLI does not refresh it.
envVars.QUBRICS_API_KEY: Optional Qubrics API key or scoped agent token used by CLI, SDK, HTTP, or MCP examples.
envVars.QUBRICS_ROOT_KEY: Example secret-store variable for a root key; explicitly pass its value through QUBRICS_API_KEY or the authorised request header.
envVars.QUBRICS_MBX_KEY: Example secret-store variable for a mailbox key; explicitly pass its value through QUBRICS_API_KEY or the authorised request header.
envVars.QUBRICS_BASE_URL: Optional Qubrics API base URL override for CLI examples.
envVars.QUBRICS_MCP_SURFACES: Inherited alias supported by the unpublished MCP source; leave unset for the released local MCP workflow.
envVars.QUBRICS_MCP_OPENAPI_INPUT_DIR: Inherited alias supported by the unpublished MCP source; leave unset for the released local MCP workflow.
envVars.QUBRICS_MCP_APP_OPENAPI: Inherited alias supported by the unpublished MCP source; leave unset for the released local MCP workflow.
envVars.QUBRICS_MCP_SENDING_OPENAPI: Inherited alias supported by the unpublished MCP source; leave unset for the released local MCP workflow.
envVars.QUBRICS_MCP_ALLOW_UNAUTHENTICATED_HTTP: Inherited alias supported by the unpublished MCP source; leave unset for the released local MCP workflow.

qubrics-attachments.description: Move email attachments through Qubrics without putting file bytes in model context, using presigned URLs through MCP or file paths through CLI and SDK helpers.

qubrics-cli.description: Use the Qubrics CLI for durable agent inbox registration, owner invites, profiles, and terminal-driven Management, Mailbox, and Sending workflows.

qubrics-email-for-agents.description: Give OpenClaw agents a Qubrics inbox to receive, triage, route, reply to, and send email with owner approval and scoped credentials.

qubrics-getting-started.description: Set up Qubrics for agents, register a durable inbox without an existing key, link an owner, choose a runtime surface, and make the first harmless call.

qubrics-mailbox-agent.description: Let an OpenClaw agent read, search, count, sync, triage, file, delete, thread, manage private calendars and non-sending events, and reply from one Qubrics mailbox efficiently.

qubrics-management.description: Manage Qubrics domains, mailboxes, mailbox keys, sending accounts, webhooks, logs, billing, and account-level setup.

qubrics-mcp-setup.description: Connect OpenClaw and other agent clients to hosted or local Qubrics MCP servers for mailbox, sending, and management tools.

qubrics-send-email.description: Send one or many emails through Qubrics using approved mailbox or agent credentials, idempotency keys, attachments, MCP, CLI, SDKs, or HTTP.

qubrics-token-efficient-usage.description: Choose low-token Qubrics calls across MCP, CLI, SDKs, and HTTP by using snippets, counts, batches, deltas, cursors, ETags, and idempotency.

qubrics-agent-email-inbox.description: Use when an AI agent needs read-only triage of an existing Qubrics inbox or unsent reply text from its messages. Trigger for bounded inbox reviews, unread invoice or support searches, and draft-only replies, including agent inbox requests without the Qubrics name. Mailbox mutations and sending are outside this workflow.

qubrics-email-for-ai-agents.description: Use when an AI agent needs to send one outbound email through Qubrics with human approval, including a status notification or delegated agent send. Trigger when preparing the exact message for approval, executing an approved send, or reconciling an uncertain retry. Use only for a single-message workflow; bulk and batch sends are outside its scope.
